title: Copper & pears — an oil study
description: Copper, fruit, and linen. Warm light meeting cool reflections.
process: 57 oil strokes selected in batches of 3–4 after screenshots. All 17 notes and 29 camera moments were recorded live. The oil model was corrected at stroke 18; early observations describe the original experiment, and replay uses the corrected model.

title: Where the evening goes
description: A pale sailboat finds its way through the last light of the day.
process: Painted from blank paper in eleven three-stroke batches, chosen after whole-view and close-up screenshots. All 12 teaching notes and 23 camera moments were recorded live.

title: Afternoon Flowers
description: Warm afternoon light, a blue vase, and a few bright flowers.
process: 34 strokes selected in batches of 1–3 after close and whole-view screenshots. This guided tour’s teaching notes were adapted afterward from the original session’s commentary.

title: Light returns to the harbor
description: A lighthouse, sailboat, and wildflowers around a busy harbor.
process: A 341-stroke scripted foundation followed by seven refinements chosen with close and whole-view inspections. No recorded teaching notes.

title: Where the quiet water goes
description: Where the quiet water goes. A small boat, soft water, and a little shoreline.
process: The first 75-stroke study: a 57-stroke scripted foundation, followed by 18 marks chosen after screenshot inspections. No recorded teaching notes.
